panelDescription: Your place on Contest Online ScoreBoard, with the stations around you
postDescription: Sends your score to contestonlinescore.com every few minutes while you are making contacts, whether or not the Live Scoreboard pane is on screen.
breakdownLabel: Send the band and mode breakdown
breakdownDescription: Your contacts on each band and mode, for the board’s breakdown view. Off, only your totals are sent.
boardDescription: A contest_id number or a scoreboard link. Leave it blank to find the operation's contest by itself.
noContest: Add a contest to this operation to see its live scoreboard.
boardNotFound: No scoreboard for {{contest}} on contestonlinescore.com right now. Name one in this pane's settings.
boardEmpty: Nobody has posted a score yet.
boardUnreadable: Can’t find a contest_id in “{{input}}”. Enter the board’s number or its link.
exportFailed: Could not read this contest’s Cabrillo log: {{message}}
noLogShared: the app did not share this log
noContestLine: the log has no CONTEST: line
boardStale: Board as of {{time}}; could not read it again: {{message}}.
notOnBoard: {{call}} is not on this board yet.
postIdle: Not posting: switch on “Post my score” under Settings › Application Preferences › Assistants.
postNoContest: Not posting: this operation has no contest.
postNoCall: Not posting: set this operation’s station call.
postNoAccount: Not posting: enter your password under Settings → Accounts → Contest Online ScoreBoard.
postNotLive: Not posting: this log has no contacts in the last hour.
postNoScores: Not posting: this version of the app does not share its scores with extensions yet.
postNoTally: Not posting: the contest has no total for this log yet.
postNoExport: Not posting: could not read this contest’s Cabrillo log: {{message}}
postNotOnBoard: Not posting: contestonlinescore.com does not take {{contest}}.
postFailed: Could not post the score: {{message}}. Trying again in a minute.
accountDescription: Your callsign’s password on contestonlinescore.com, which “Post my score” sends your scores with.
passwordPostface: Register your callsign on contestonlinescore.com to get one.
passwordSaved: Saved. The first score posted checks it.
